import ctypes
import math

def gsl_cdf_chisq_Pinv(P, nu):
    # Load the required dynamic libraries
    ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so", mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
    gsl = ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so")

    # Define the argument and return types for gsl_cdf_chisq_Pinv
    gsl.gsl_cdf_chisq_Pinv.argtypes = [ctypes.c_double, ctypes.c_double]
    gsl.gsl_cdf_chisq_Pinv.restype = ctypes.c_double

    # Call the C function and return the result
    return gsl.gsl_cdf_chisq_Pinv(ctypes.c_double(P), ctypes.c_double(nu))

def assert_test():
    # Test case 1: P = 0.5, nu = 2
    result = gsl_cdf_chisq_Pinv(0.5, 2)
    expected = 1.3862943611198906  # Precomputed value
    assert math.isclose(result, expected, rel_tol=1e-6), f"Test case 1 failed: {result} != {expected}"

    # Test case 2: P = 0.95, nu = 10
    result = gsl_cdf_chisq_Pinv(0.95, 10)
    expected = 18.307038053275146  # Precomputed value
    assert math.isclose(result, expected, rel_tol=1e-6), f"Test case 2 failed: {result} != {expected}"

    # Test case 3: P = 0.99, nu = 5
    result = gsl_cdf_chisq_Pinv(0.99, 5)
    expected = 15.08627246938899  # Precomputed value
    assert math.isclose(result, expected, rel_tol=1e-6), f"Test case 3 failed: {result} != {expected}"

    # Test case 4: Edge case, P close to 0
    result = gsl_cdf_chisq_Pinv(1e-6, 2)
    expected = 2.000002000002e-06  # Precomputed value
    assert math.isclose(result, expected, rel_tol=1e-6), f"Test case 4 failed: {result} != {expected}"

    # Test case 5: Edge case, P close to 1
    result = gsl_cdf_chisq_Pinv(0.999999, 2)
    expected = 27.63102111592855  # Precomputed value
    assert math.isclose(result, expected, rel_tol=1e-6), f"Test case 5 failed: {result} != {expected}"

    print("All test cases passed!")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    assert_test()
